name: Oahe Downstream Recreation Area (Campgrounds 1 and 2)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery at 200 m half-width (0.44 m/px) over Campground 2's east rows and at 1,100 m half-width (2.4 m/px) over the whole park, every Go Outdoors SD facID=41 loop 68 (Campground 1) and loop 69 (Campground 2) unit point plotted; both frames rendered. The nearest RV sites, 100E-105E on Campground 2's east side, sit ~96-99 m from the Missouri River under continuous cottonwood canopy, with the park road, a day-use parking lot and the swim beach between them and the water. Campground 1's west rows are ~350 m from the stilling-basin channel behind woods and the park road. Both loops are downstream of Oahe Dam (pads ~446-450 m DEM against ~488 m on Lake Oahe), so judged on the river below the dam only: no RV site on or overlooking the water -> not waterfront (re-measured for Campgrounds 1 and 2 alone after Campground 3 was split out).
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=41 ('Oahe Downstream Recreation Area'), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22: loop 68 (Campground 1) 58 web-bookable electric RV sites 1E-60E (no 7E or 13E) and loop 69 (Campground 2) 99 web-bookable sites 61E-161E (no 132E; 131E listed but not sold online), all 'Back-In Campsite', 'Amp Service: 20/30/50', MaxEquipLength 44-76 ft, UnitBasePrice $30; hosts V1-V3 not sold online. GFP map 'Oahe Downstream Campgrounds 1 & 2' https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/ods_cg1_2.pdf (ArcGIS Pro, 2024-05-15) shows the two adjoining loops with the same numbering, restroom/shower buildings, water and a playground; the park overview map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/ods_overview.pdf puts them on the main park road from the entrance by the dam. GFP park page https://gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/oahe-downstream-recreation-area/: '3 campgrounds with 205 campsites' (198 sold online + 6 host sites + 131E = 205). Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel back-ins under cottonwoods at the unit points. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest 44 ft). Campground 3 (loop 70), 1.03 km away RV-site centroid to centroid across the river channel with its own road, was split out 2026-11-22. Public (state): no price gate.
note: Campgrounds 1 and 2 of Oahe Downstream Recreation Area: two adjoining loops under cottonwoods between the Missouri River and the stilling-basin channel just below Oahe Dam, 5 mi N of Fort Pierre off SD-1806, near the swim beach, boat ramps, fishing piers, modern cabins and group lodge. Campground 3, across the channel on its own road, is a separate entry; the park's dump station is on that side, by SD-1806 at the south end of the river bridge. Wintering bald eagles roost in the cottonwoods below the dam. --Claude

season.note: GFP: 'Campgrounds 1 and 2 closed to camping Nov. 15 through the last Friday of March for bald eagle winter roosting' (the last Friday of March is March 26 in 2027). Between Oct. 1 and April 30 the water systems may be off.

sites.source: https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=41 sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22: loop 68 (Campground 1) 58 web-bookable RV sites 1E-60E (7E and 13E absent), loop 69 (Campground 2) 99 web-bookable sites 61E-161E (132E absent; 131E ReservableOnline false, excluded), every one 'Back-In Campsite'; MaxEquipLength up to 76 ft at 31E (Online Content agrees); hosts V1-V3 excluded (V3's 75 ft looks like the engine default). The stored 75 ft/pull-thru came from host V3 and Campground 3's 164E. GFP map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/ods_cg1_2.pdf shows the same sites.

hookups.source: https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=41 sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22: every web-bookable site in loops 68 and 69 'Amp Service: 20/30/50'. No water or sewer attribute on any unit.

facilities.source: GFP map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/ods_cg1_2.pdf (2024-05-15): Restroom/Shower buildings by 55E, 135E and 144E (accessible), water hydrants through both loops, Vault Toilet by the day-use area east of Campground 2; GFP overview map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/ods_overview.pdf: the park's one Dump Station, by SD-1806 at the south end of the river bridge (across the channel, on Campground 3's road); https://gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/oahe-downstream-recreation-area/ amenities read 2026-11-22: Drinking Water, Dump Station, Flush Toilets, Showers, Vault Toilets (open year-round).

season.source: https://gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/oahe-downstream-recreation-area/ read 2026-11-22: 'Open: Year-round. Campgrounds 1 and 2 closed to camping Nov. 15 through the last Friday of March for bald eagle winter roosting. Day-use area and campground 3 remain open year-round. Between Oct. 1 and April 30, water systems may be closed.' Opens dated at the widest reading (the last Friday of March falls Mar 25-31).

booking.source: https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=41 read 2026-11-22: Campgrounds 1 and 2's sites (loops 68 and 69) are ReservableOnline on the park's facility (shared with Campground 3); GFP park page 'Make reservation online or call 1.800.710.2267.'

_reasons: Campground 3 (engine loop 70, 41 RV sites 163E-205E) sits 1.03 km RV-site centroid to centroid from Campgrounds 1-2 (loops 68+69, adjoining, 362 m apart), across the ~200 m-wide river channel below Oahe Dam, on its own road from SD-1806 south of the bridge (about 3 km by road), with its own season (open year-round while 1-2 close Nov 15 - late March); split out. Kept entry re-cut to Campgrounds 1 and 2: name, pin moved 55 m to their RV-site centroid, elevation, waterfront evidence, inclusion_evidence, note, sites (157, 76 ft, no pull-thrus), season (closed Nov 15 - last Friday of March), facilities/hookups/booking provenance.
